name: synthetic-fetch-ok
description: SYNTHETIC happy chain for keenable#v1/fetch. Shape taken from a real 2026-09-16 GET /v1/fetch/public?url=https://example.com response (url, title, content, description); URL rewritten to the authenticated /v1/fetch the doc calls. The caller omits live, so the request carries none (design D6, revised 2026-11-07). The `usage` receipt shape is from a 2026-11-13 authenticated response (values synthetic); the provider consolidate removes it from the output (design D11). Replace via `deno task record` when KEENABLE_API_KEY exists.
